refute_spans.quote: A Joint Framework of Denoising Autoencoder and Generative Vocoder for Monaural Speech Enhancement
In this study, a Mel-domain denoising autoencoder and a deep generative vocoder are stacked to form a joint framework for monaural speech enhancement
In the proposed method, a convolutional recurrent network (CRN) is trained to map the noisy Mel power spectrum to the clean counterpart.
Experimental results show that the proposed joint frame- work signiﬁcantly improves speech intelligibility and perceptual quality for both trained and untrained noises.
